content.text: Really common at 5, and it's a habit that's very fixable. Tonight, tell Milo calmly before bed: "You sleep in your bed, and if you wake up, you can come say hi and I'll walk you right back." Then when he shows up, don't debate it or let him in. Just walk him back, quietly and boringly, every time. The first few nights are the hardest because he's testing whether the rule is real.
